assumptions: Integers k>=2, n>=2k; graph KG(n,k); total cut parameter alpha(KG(n,k)); integral homology and natural S_n action.
scientific_integrity: Complete explicit proof of the stated infinite-family theorem; finite certificate examples corroborate but are not used to prove generality. Prior literature might contain an unindexed equivalent theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only extremal maximum-independent-set cut level; no non-extremal parameters or equivariant homotopy splitting. Known EKR equality, nerve lemma and central binomial valuations are inputs; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Extremal Kneser total-cut complexes: a homotopy transition and a binary orientation law
